gap: No result ChatGPT got states a named, measured switching time, latency or power draw for any of the 8-port switches ChatGPT showed (AUTYUE 8x1 HDMI, AUTYUE 8x2 HDMI+DP, StarTech R8AD122-KVM-SWITCH, the $399 'Upgraded 8 Port HDMI' unit) or for TESmart's HKS801 line. No reviewer or lab I could find has published such a figure either, so this angle gives the page no new measured fact.
standout_why: I opened officekithq.com (rank 2), mamalinux.com (7), virtual-pc.com (8), workcocoon.com (9), kvmswitchtech.com (1) and both dockgearhq.com pages (3, 4). Officekithq says it does not run product trials. Kvmswitchtech says it did not invent latency numbers. Dockgearhq, workcocoon and mamalinux give spec-sheet figures only, and mamalinux's '1 sec' Reyoten switching time has no source. The only reviewer-measured 8-port figures anywhere are on virtual-pc.com: Kevin Anderson's switching times for MT-VIKI (about 2 s) and JideTech (1–2 s). That rival already has them, so they don't stand out. None of these pages has measurements for the products ChatGPT actually showed, and I found no outside lab measurements for those products to add.
decides: Nothing here changes the pick. No named reviewer or lab has measured TESmart HKS801-P23/-L23/-M24, AUTYUE 8-port, StarTech R8AD122 or ATEN CS18208. The page should choose on sourced maker specs (4K60 vs 4K30, USB 3.0 vs 2.0, RS232/LAN control, HDMI 2.1 on the HKS801-M24) and say plainly that no independent measurements exist. It should not borrow measurements from other brands.
